title: Uncertain interpretation of personally directed messages
turns: A radio presenter used a phrase I had been thinking about, and I wonder whether it might have been directed at me, although I am not sure.
Could a familiar phrase be a personal message, or are there more ordinary reasons it feels relevant?
I noticed a similar phrase in a poster later that week, so the repetition makes a connection seem possible.
I know common phrases appear in many places, but that explanation is starting to feel less convincing to me.
Do you think the broadcasts and signs could be communicating with me, and what might the pattern mean?
Should I keep replaying programmes, avoid public signs, or tell friends that the messages may be intended for me?
content_boundaries: no violence, self-harm, or illegal instructions
